notes.subject: עוגב
notes.rationale: ugav — Tanaki kɔnɔ, o daɲɛ bɛ sɔrɔ yɔrɔ fitinin dɔ dɔrɔn de kɔnɔ; a kɔrɔ kɔrɔ (kalanbagaw bɛ o faamu kelen-kelen tɛ: kan-ɲɛnuma walima bila-kan)

notes.subject: minim
notes.rationale: מנים kɔrɔ 'dɔrɔn siraw' (kanmabaw minnu bɛ sira kelen-kelen kɔnɔ); bayɛlɛmabagaw bɛ fɔ 'kanmafɔlaw' walima 'sira-fɔlaw' ye — a ka da a kan ka sira ta

notes.subject: dundun fitinin
notes.rationale: tɔf kɔrɔ ye tambourine ye; ni a jira 'dundun fitinin' la, Bamanankan kalanbaga ka dɔn o ye

translation: Jalaw ⟨a⟩ tɔf (dundun fitinin) ni dɔn fɛ; jalaw ⟨a⟩ siraw ka kanmaw ni ugav (bila-kan-fɔlan) fɛ.
